text: Before you reprimand your child, take a deep breath. The Prophet said: 'Indeed, Allah is Rafeeq and loves rifq in all things' — and rifq begins with the tone of your voice before your words.

review_defects.arabic: إن الله رفيق يحب الرفق في كل شيء
review_defects.english: Indeed, Allah is Rafeeq and loves rifq in all things
review_defects.description: The key Islamic terms 'رفيق' (Gentle/Kind) and 'الرفق' (gentleness/kindness) are transliterated without translation or gloss, leaving the hadith's meaning opaque to English readers. The subsequent use of 'rifq' in the commentary compounds the issue.
The honorific 'ﷺ' is dropped in the English rendering.
